# clickhouse_clickstack_source (Data Source)

Looks up a ClickStack source by name and, optionally, kind. Use it to reference sources Terraform doesn't manage, such as the ones ClickHouse Cloud creates for a service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the sources ClickHouse Cloud created for the service, so dashboards
# and saved searches can reference them without hardcoding ids.
data "clickhouse_clickstack_source" "default" {
  for_each = {
    logs     = { name = "Logs", kind = "log" }
    traces   = { name = "Traces", kind = "trace" }
    metrics  = { name = "Metrics", kind = "metric" }
    sessions = { name = "Sessions", kind = "session" }
  }

  name = each.value.name
  kind = each.value.kind
}

output "source_ids" {
  value = { for k, s in data.clickhouse_clickstack_source.default : k => s.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the source to look up.

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Kind of the source: one of `log`, `trace`, `metric`, `session`, `promql`. Set it when sources of different kinds share a name.
- `team` (String) Team ID to look the source up under, sent as the `x-hdx-team` header. Defaults to the API key's team.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) ID of the ClickHouse connection the source reads through.
- `database_name` (String) ClickHouse database the source reads from.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the source.
- `table_name` (String) ClickHouse table the source reads from. Empty for `metric` sources.
